assertions.summary: One food effect active at a time; later food cancels previous effect.
Unpreserved food spoils after 1 in-game day; enchanted food spoils twice as fast unless preserved.
Multiple enchanted foods within one hour: Constitution save DC 10 + total enchantments; failures escalate subsequent DC by +2.
Every Chaos Chow meal consumed in one hour increases overload DC by +2.
Overload Constitution save DC = 10 + number of Chaos Chow meals consumed in past hour.
Uncommon Frostberries/Dragonfruit/Basilisk Eggs; Rare Phoenix Feathers/Chrono-Crystals/Voidfruit.
Mana salts, phoenix feathers, elemental fruits are enchantment ingredient examples.
Dimensional Cuisine, Culinary Masterpiece, Reality-Bending Cuisine, Eternal Feast retain their authored meal-level effects and gates.

priceRule: All gp cost/range assertions remain source provenance only; MIB-13 owns current price and market scarcity.

source.authorityRule: Preserve source-authored culinary outcomes at meal/recipe/enchantment scope. Do not project finished-food effects backward onto raw ingredients or derived preparations without an explicit ingredient-level assertion.
